technical.summary: Extreme oversold conditions present recovery potential, but lack of bullish confirmation across momentum, volume, and price structure makes this a low-probability entry with significant downside risk.

fundamental.summary: EVRG shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signals, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and elevated earnings risk in 42 days—fundamentals lack bullish catalysts.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (14/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but weak congressional activity and absent news sentiment limit conviction.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (317), strong dollar pressures utilities, FOMC just concluded; earnings in 42 days adds moderate event risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Extreme RSI oversold (9-period) combined with contrarian fear sentiment (14/100) and supertrend bullish signal creates technical recovery potential with price near support at 56.44.
debate.key_bear_argument: Macro environment is severely hostile (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis, strong dollar headwind to utilities), fundamentals lack conviction (no insider buying, no institutional accumulation, high earnings risk in 42 days), and critical momentum indicators (MACD bearish, CMF negative, OBV flat) fail to confirm oversold bounce—price below all major moving averages signals structural weakness.

decision.entry_rationale: Extreme oversold RSI (9-period) and contrarian fear sentiment (14/100) present technical recovery potential, but this is outweighed by severe macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis) and fundamental weakness (no insider conviction, high earnings risk in 42 days).
